_readme: Known models per backend: what the Models dialog offers, what each model's reasoning effort may be, and which tier each suits. Detection wins where a CLI can list models (Codex: `codex debug models`; Gemini: the API's models.list when GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY is set); this file fills in the rest and is the only source for Claude Code, which has no list command. Shape adapted from Ghostex's agent-model-catalog.json (github.com/maddada/Ghostex, MIT). Bump updatedAt on every edit.
